steps.what: Evaluate students' arguments, evidence and sociological reasoning against the assignment criteria
Compose feedback on the assessed argument and its use of evidence

loop.purpose: Turn instructor notes into specific feedback prose
loop.input: Assessment notes and quoted assignment passages
loop.check: Verify that comments represent the student's actual argument and the instructor's judgement without adding unsupported criticism
loop.stop: One draft and correction; ambiguous comments are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Individual arguments need contextual explanation beyond a fixed comment bank

steps.what: Determine the grade and approve final assignment feedback

tasks.design: Use native {LMS} feedback features to draft text from the teacher's assessment notes. Keep close reading, sociological judgement and each grade decision fully counted; official record publication remains a separate task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specific feedback required prose-writing after substantive assessment was complete.
tasks.enabler_now: Instructor-note-based drafting can supply text for teacher correction.
tasks.still_hard: Alternative theoretical positions and weak evidence must be distinguished fairly.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognizes a defensible interpretation that differs from their own.
tasks.altitude: A little feedback composition time returns to examining reasoning and evidence.

reach.task: Prepare specific comments under an examiner's direction

evidence.claim: D2L Brightspace Lumi Feedback drafts feedback from instructor notes; it does not establish autonomous sociology grades or a local time saving.
Model knowledge: feedback-writing savings are an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary covers non-exam assignments and their grade decisions, excluding examinations and official record transfer.

The teacher produces counted s1 notes with submission version, criterion, quoted evidence, assessment and intended advice. Missing or ambiguous evidence is checked manually; a generated criterion score is not assumed.
Test existing comment banks and native feedback drafting before custom tools.
Four incremental focal hours cover instruction checks and sample feedback audits.
unknowns: Institutional use restrictions and existing tools
research_questions: Does checked feedback drafting reduce total marking time while preserving fairness to different theoretical arguments?

approvals.approved_version: Exact submission, criteria version, grade decision and feedback text; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R93.75 gives6.25 gross minus4 upkeep =2.25 net. Short comments or theoretically complex papers requiring rewriting support only0-1% conservative saving.

steps.what: Initiate classroom discussions, facilitate participation and moderate exchanges about sociological questions

tasks.design: Retain live discussion with the teacher, using {DOCS} readings for reference. The teacher invites participation, challenges claims and manages sensitive exchanges as they unfold.
tasks.previous_blocker: The next useful intervention depends on the actual contributions and classroom context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reading material supports discussion without replacing facilitation.
tasks.still_hard: Unequal participation and sensitive social topics require careful judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognizes discomfort, exclusion and productive disagreement.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in facilitation responsibility or contact time.

reach.task: Help students articulate and examine an argument

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: classroom facilitation remains human interaction; no equivalent shorter discussion is established.

assumptions: Boundary is live classroom discussion, excluding separately prepared lecture material and grading.
Students produce contributions during discussion; the teacher interprets and responds during fully counted s1. No participation or understanding flag is assumed.
Use existing reading and teaching tools before custom moderation support.
Zero incremental upkeep because no recording, model or additional process is introduced.
research_questions: Can existing reading prompts improve participation without reducing discussion time?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Quiet classes and contested discussions both retain live teacher facilitation.

steps.what: Compile and administer examinations, checking items, scoring rules and collected submissions
Mark closed questions using the validated response and points rules
Judge open examination answers, resolve exceptions and set final results

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} closed-question marking after the teacher verifies the answer key. Retain exam design, administration, essay judgement and final decisions; do not infer a correct sociological argument from a matching keyword.
tasks.previous_blocker: A limited subset of fixed-answer questions still required manual key comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing assessment functions apply explicit response rules without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Essays and ambiguous questions require interpretation and examiner responsibility.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher identifies valid reasoning and substantive misunderstanding in context.
tasks.altitude: A little repetitive marking time returns to open answers and disputed items.

reach.task: Apply an examiner's checked scoring procedures
reach.learn: Item validation and escalation of disputed scoring

evidence.claim: Ans automatically marks closed questions; this capability does not establish automatic essay judgement.
Model knowledge: the saving depends on a currently manual closed-question component.

assumptions: Boundary covers the teacher's examinations, excluding non-exam assignment marking and official record transfer. The scenario does not remove teaching-assistant labour.

The teacher creates and checks s1 item identifiers, allowed answers, points, key version and roster mappings. Students produce responses during the exam; s1 includes checking the collected submission manifest afterwards. Missing identities, ambiguous keys or unsupported responses require manual marking.
Test native assessment configuration first; already automatic scoring and system runtime earn no new labour credit.
Seven incremental focal hours cover key tests and scoring audits.
research_questions: Does configured closed marking reproduce examiner-checked scores while preserving all open-answer judgement?

already_counted.description: Item preparation, input capture and exam administration
Open grading, exception resolution and final decision

incremental.description: Test answer keys and audit scoring

approvals.approved_version: Exact exam submissions, key version, corrections and final results; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R85 gives15 gross minus7 upkeep =8 net. Essay-only examinations or already automated scoring support only0-2% conservative saving.

steps.what: Select lecture aims, readings and evidence on social relations and research methods
Prepare lecture explanations and examples from the selected sources

loop.purpose: Draft explanations and examples for the defined lecture
loop.input: Lecture brief and verified source passages
loop.check: Verify theoretical distinctions, research claims, examples and representation of social groups against the readings
loop.stop: One draft and correction; unsupported or misleading material is rewritten manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations and examples need contextual composition beyond a slide template

steps.what: Check final material and deliver lectures with clarification of students' questions

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} templates and source-bound drafting for lecture material, retaining source selection and scientific checking. The teacher finalizes the material and delivers the lecture personally; separate classroom discussion time is excluded.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparing explanations required repeated rewriting of selected source material.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can propose inspectable wording and examples.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle theoretical differences and sensitive social examples can be distorted by fluent text.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher understands the class and can adapt explanations when students are confused.
tasks.altitude: A small amount of preparation time returns to evaluating examples and conceptual clarity.

reach.task: Align lecture examples with learning outcomes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound lecture drafting is plausible; no local sociology lecture-preparation saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is lecture preparation and delivery, excluding separate curriculum redesign, moderated discussions and student assessment.

The teacher produces s1 aims, class level, selected source passages, concepts, permitted examples and time constraints. Capture and selection remain counted; missing or contentious evidence requires manual reading and writing rather than invented examples or citations.
Use existing lecture templates and reusable material before custom drafting.
Four incremental focal hours cover source and instruction maintenance.
unknowns: Preparation versus delivery time and existing material reuse
research_questions: Does checked drafting reduce preparation without blurring theoretical distinctions or introducing unsupported claims?

already_counted.description: Final material check and lecture delivery

incremental.description: Maintain source set and drafting instructions

approvals.approved_version: Exact final lecture material, source versions and examples; changes require a renewed content check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R93.75 gives6.25 gross minus4 upkeep =2.25 net. Reused lectures or material needing substantial theoretical correction support only0-1% conservative saving; delivery remains unchanged.
